content_units: For a leisure trip with   only a carry-on  ,   Option A is the best value  . It gives you nonstop flights and included carry-on for a much lower total cost than Option C, while avoiding the extra time and hassle that make Option B less attractive after baggage fees.
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
Option A   08:10 AM   11:45 AM   3h 35m   Non-stop   EUR 184
Option B   7h 40m total   7h 40m total   7h 40m each way   1 stop   EUR 198
Option C   11:20 AM   02:55 PM   3h 35m   Non-stop   EUR 228
-   Why it wins:   Lowest-cost nonstop option with   carry-on included  , which matches your trip style well.
-   Best for:   Travelers who want to keep costs down without sacrificing convenience.
-   Trade-off:   No seat selection, and the outbound is a relatively early start.
- Return time is convenient for a final full day in Athens
- 08:10 departure may feel early for a leisure trip
2) Option C — Best comfort, but weaker value
-   Why it ranks second:   Best schedule and added seat selection, but the price premium is fairly high for a short leisure trip.
-   Best for:   Travelers who care more about comfort and timing than price.
- Costs   EUR 44 more than Option A
- Comfort upgrade may not justify the extra spend for a 5-night trip
3) Option B — Cheapest headline fare, but poorest value
-   Adjusted trip cost:   Base fare   EUR 156   + carry-on   EUR 42 total   =   EUR 198
-   Why it ranks last:   After adding carry-on, it is only slightly more expensive than A, but with much longer travel time and a stop each way.
- Could work if you travel with only a personal item
- Carry-on raises real trip cost to   EUR 198
-   7h 40m each way   is a major time penalty
- Higher disruption risk than nonstop options
It hits the strongest balance of:
Choose Option C instead only if   later departure times and seat selection are worth   EUR 44 extra   to you.
Skip Option B   unless you can truly travel with just a personal item and do not mind losing several extra hours in transit.
headings: 2) Option C — Best comfort, but weaker value
3) Option B — Cheapest headline fare, but poorest value
